row: Joan is an avid horse enthusiast and rider who has been training horses and students in the equestrian industry for over 16 years. She has worked with some of the top names in the industry and is the CEO of JSHorsemanship. Joan has trained and worked with a variety of different breeds; giving lessons to students of all ages in both Western and English disciplines. Her approach places a focus on building a healthy & happy relationship between the horse and rider. Throughout her career Joan has carried a passion to help others connect deeper with their horses and help them to achieve their goals in the equestrian industry.
